notes: `UserContext.route(pattern, handler, { times })` runs the handler for the route's first n requests, falling through and failing included, then removes the route, so the routes registered before it handle the rest. Requests paused at once each claim a use before the handler runs, so it never runs more than n times. A value that isn't a positive integer fails `route` with `InvalidInput`.

audit.scope: Public declarations and implementation inspected; a route with times removes itself after the last request it handled is decided.
